nary_nodes.label: Lakers sale to Iger and Kushner
evidence: In a stunning twist, former Disney CEO Bob Iger and venture capitalist Josh Kushner are buying one of the greatest trophy assets in US sports: The Los Angeles Lakers.

Iger and Kushner, the brother of President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner, are shelling out a record-breaking $12.5 billion for the basketball team, a person familiar with the matter told CNN.
Iger and Kushner confirmed the deal, first reported by ESPN, in a statement on Wednesday.
nary_nodes.type_justification: The example is a sale event, matching SaleEvent.

nary_nodes.label: NBA Board approval needed
evidence: The deal still needs the approval of the NBA’s Board of Governors to be completed.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Approval is an expression of liking, matching UserLikes.

nary_nodes.label: Walter's majority purchase
evidence: Mark Walter, whose Guggenheim Investments, owns the Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team, bought a majority interest in the Lakers in a deal announced just over a year ago.
That deal valued the team at $10 billion, although Walter did not buy 100% ownership.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Purchase is a sale event, matching SaleEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Federal investigation into Guggenheim
evidence: Late last month, The Wall Street Journal reported an internal whistleblower complaint about Walter’s Guggenheim Investments triggered a federal investigation.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Investigation is an act of examining, matching CheckAction.

nary_nodes.label: Thrive Eternal financing
evidence: Thrive Eternal, a new holding company focused on sports and entertainment investments, is expected to be involved in financing the Lakers purchase, the source told CNN.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Financing is a financial transaction, closest to SaleEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Iger and Kushner statement
evidence: “As lifelong NBA fans, we are deeply honored for the opportunity to become stewards of the Los Angeles Lakers, one of the most iconic sports franchises in the world,” Iger and Kushner said in the statement.
“Our long-term commitment is to build on that foundation, compete at the highest level, and serve this extraordinary team, its fans, and the city of Los Angeles.”

nary_nodes.label: Walter's statement
evidence: “Owning the Los Angeles Lakers has been one of the great honors of my life – an extraordinary investment, but what I will carry with me is the community, the fans, and a city that treats this team as family,” Walter said in statement to ESPN.

nary_nodes.label: Banker's comment on quick sale
evidence: “No one flips a premiere sports franchise in less than a year. I’ve never seen anything like this,” one banker involved in sports deals told CNN.

nary_nodes.label: Guggenheim response
evidence: a spokesperson for Guggenheim’s parent company told the Journal they have “always acted in good faith,” are cooperating with authorities and are confident it will get “resolved favorably.”
